I reviewed each key item against the transcript's final agreed figures, owners and dates.

**Notable findings:**
- All four account actions carry the *final* figures (QCD at $15,000 not the corrected $12,000; remainder at $32,388 not $35,388) — good.
- Ownership transfer on the parish-info task was caught (moved from Lorraine to Everett at 00:20:34), and the projection due date reflects the revision from the 23rd to the 30th.
- **i6 is missing entirely**: Joelle's commitment to prepare both the Roth conversion form (zero withholding) and the December RMD distribution form (50% federal), dated to process the first week of December and signed before the 17th, has no record item.
- No declined/deferred items (QLAC, 529, 40/60, QCD-to-DAF) leaked into the record, and there are no duplicates or unsupported entries.

key_items.note: Captures Maisie Jane's birth; the carried figure '7 pounds, 2 ounces' matches Lorraine at 00:01:03. Birth date Aug 27 omitted but no figure is wrong.
Knee replacement with November 17th matches; right knee, hospital stay, 6 weeks PT and no-driving detail omitted but nothing stated is wrong.
QCD to Saint Fintan Parish from Everett's IRA at 15,000 — the corrected pledge amount, not the initial 12,000.
Remaining RMD as taxable distribution at 32,388 — the revised figure after the pledge increase, not 35,388. December timing and 50% withholding not captured but no wrong figure.
Roth conversion of 70,000 from Lorraine's traditional IRA to her Roth; matches the confirmed amount at 00:21:59.
DAF funding at 40,000 of Kettleby from the joint account, Stadtler Family Fund at Carrow Valley — all correct.
Owner correctly reassigned to Everett after the handoff from Lorraine at 00:20:34; due Oct 19, 2026 is the Monday following the Thursday Oct 15 meeting, matching 'I'll email it Monday morning.'
Joelle to build and send the QCD request; 'I can have it out to you Wednesday' = Oct 21, 2026. Owner and date correct.
Tobias to send the full conversion projection to clients and Hal; due Oct 30 correctly reflects the slip from the 23rd due to the custodian conference.
Joelle's DAF application plus stock transfer letter; 'out to both of you by Tuesday' = Oct 20, 2026. No figure carried, so figures pass.
Lorraine to call Hal for a first-half-of-November meeting; 'I'll call Hal tomorrow' = Oct 16, 2026. The state-tax question is omitted but the core task, owner and date are right.

No record item covers Joelle preparing the Roth conversion form (Lorraine, zero withholding) and the December RMD distribution form (Everett, 50% federal) after Hal signs off, dated to process the first week of December and signed before the Nov 17 surgery (00:22:10).
